part.text: The API currently stores only `username`, so I’ll preserve the existing registration contract while accepting and persisting an optional `email`; notification delivery will use that email and fall back to the username for existing users. The trigger will run only on a real transition from a non-completed status, after the task update has been persisted, and will enqueue via Celery’s `delay()` rather than execute email work in the request.
